# LeetMap Pro

> LeetMap Pro is a free, high-speed platform organizing community-reported company-wise LeetCode and SQL interview questions by frequency and recency.

## Overview

LeetMap Pro tracks coding interview questions asked by 660+ top technology companies (Google, Meta, Amazon, Microsoft, Apple, Bloomberg, Citadel, Netflix, and more). It provides real-time filtering across 30-day, 3-month, and 6-month recency windows, interactive DSA pattern roadmaps, curated SQL practice, and progress synchronization.

## Core Features & Resources

- [About, Sources & Methodology](https://www.leetmap-pro.com/about): Data provenance, update process, ranking methodology, editorial principles, and correction policy.
- [Company-Wise Coding Questions](https://www.leetmap-pro.com/): Browse 660+ tech companies with interview questions ranked by recency and frequency.
- [SQL Interview Practice Hub](https://www.leetmap-pro.com/sql): Curated SQL and relational database questions asked by 70+ tech companies.
- [DSA Pattern Guides](https://www.leetmap-pro.com/patterns): 22 algorithmic patterns (Two Pointers, Sliding Window, Monotonic Stack, Dynamic Programming, Graphs) with strategy breakdowns and templates.
- [Technical Interview Strategy Roadmap](https://www.leetmap-pro.com/strategy): Interactive prerequisite dependency graph for coding interview preparation.
- [Time & Space Complexity Reference](https://www.leetmap-pro.com/patterns/time-complexity): Visual Big-O guide, growth curves, and recursion tree cheat sheets.

## API & Data Feeds

- [Companies JSON API](https://www.leetmap-pro.com/api/companies): Machine-readable company catalog and aggregate problem counts.
- [SQL JSON API](https://www.leetmap-pro.com/api/sql): Machine-readable SQL company and problem catalog.
- [Dataset Status API](https://www.leetmap-pro.com/api/status): Current dataset publication time, source commits, and synchronization status.
- [Daily Challenge API](https://www.leetmap-pro.com/api/daily-challenge): Current LeetCode daily challenge metadata.
- [RSS Feed](https://www.leetmap-pro.com/feed.xml): Company, pattern, and dataset update entries.
- [Atom Feed](https://www.leetmap-pro.com/atom.xml): Atom-formatted company, pattern, and dataset update entries.
- [Sitemap](https://www.leetmap-pro.com/sitemap.xml): Comprehensive URL index of all company interview hubs and pattern guides.
- [Open Source Repository](https://github.com/saitarrun/LeetMap-Pro): Full source code and daily automated data synchronization scripts.
